core_obligations: Build the presheaf and its restriction maps (proof lines 9973-9988): for h : V' -> V the pullback functor h^* : C_V -> C_{V'} with its strongly cartesian morphisms h^*U -> U covering h gives a transformation F|_{C_V} -> F|_{C_{V'}} o h^*, hence by functoriality of colimits a map H(V) -> H(V') between the colimits.
Reduce to an adjunction check (proof lines 9989-9994): it suffices to show Mor_{PSh(D)}(H, G) = Mor_{Sh(C)}(F, pi^{-1}G) for every sheaf G on C.

Identify both sides (proof lines 9995-10002): an element of the left-hand side is a compatible system of maps F(U) -> G(p(U)) over all U in C, and since pi^{-1}G(U) = G(p(U)) by the choice of topology on C the right-hand side consists of exactly the same data, so the presheaf H represents the functor Hom(F, pi^{-1}-) and hence its sheafification is pi_!F.
proof_roadmap: Use pullback functors and strongly cartesian morphisms to define the restriction maps of the presheaf U |-> colim over the fibre category.
Show the resulting presheaf is left adjoint to pi^{-1} by comparing morphism sets.
Identify pi^{-1}G(U) with G(p(U)) to finish the comparison in one step.
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the lower shriek along a fibred category as the sheafification of the presheaf sending V to the colimit of F over the fibre category C_V (statement lines 9959-9970). The proof (proof lines 9972-10002) uses pullback functors along morphisms of the base to define the restriction maps through functoriality of colimits, and then verifies the defining adjunction by comparing morphism sets, using pi^{-1}G(U) = G(p(U)). H2: one construction plus one adjunction check, written out.
